description: This Java source file defines a service class 'DomainServices' in a Spring-based backend application. It contains multiple methods for managing projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications. The class interacts with various repositories and a geo service to perform create, read, update, delete, and auxiliary operations relevant to a domain module of a tourism infrastructure monitoring system.

classes.name: DomainServices
classes.description: Service class providing domain operation methods for projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications within a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new project with provided details and saves it to the project repository.

methods.name: listProjects
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of all projects.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches a project by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Updates details of an existing project with the provided data.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Deletes a project by its ID.

methods.name: createContractor
methods.description: Creates a new contractor with provided details.

methods.name: listContractors
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of contractors.

methods.name: updateContractor
methods.description: Updates an existing contractor's details.

methods.name: createTender
methods.description: Creates a new tender associated with a project.

methods.name: listProjectTenders
methods.description: Lists tenders for a specific project with pagination.

methods.name: updateTender
methods.description: Updates an existing tender.

methods.name: createContract
methods.description: Creates a new contract linking a project and a contractor.

methods.name: listProjectContracts
methods.description: Lists contracts associated with a project.

methods.name: updateContract
methods.description: Updates details of a specific contract.

methods.name: createMilestone
methods.description: Creates a project milestone.

methods.name: listMilestones
methods.description: Lists milestones for a project.

methods.name: updateMilestone
methods.description: Updates milestone information.

methods.name: updateMilestoneProgressWithGeo
methods.description: Updates milestone progress, optionally geocoding location if coordinates are provided.

methods.name: createInspection
methods.description: Creates a project inspection, with optional milestone association, and reverse geocodes location if needed.

methods.name: recordHandover
methods.description: Records a project handover, marks project as completed.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Creates a financial fund entry for a project.

methods.name: createPayment
methods.description: Creates a payment record linked to project, contract, contractor, and optionally milestone.

methods.name: updatePaymentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a payment.

methods.name: getUserNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves notifications for a user.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Creates and saves a new notification message (admin only).
